clarity.justification: The plan directly tests the hypothesis by selecting “outcome-matched inputs,” fitting a “route classifier,” and comparing matched-outcome route AUROC against shuffled, random-model, outcome-only, and surface-feature controls. Its predictions are directional and refutable: “above-chance route accuracy indicates the model encodes mechanism beyond outcome,” while the proposed positive relationship between “per-outcome RSS” and “transfer-within-route minus transfer-across-route” would fail if separability or that correlation were absent. However, “statistically indistinguishable outcome distributions,” the aggregation defining RSS, and an edit that “fails/behaves differently on route-B inputs” lack decision thresholds or exact formulas, and route decodability alone does not fully identify the claimed “mechanistic understanding.”

feasibility.justification: The hardest step is to “learn a route-specific activation edit (steering direction) that shifts the outcome”; activation steering and patching are supported standard techniques, but this operation is underdefined because the listed base encoders are not given scalar outcome heads or a precise outcome-shift objective. ESM-2, ChemBERTa, MolFormer, MegaScale, FireProtDB, and Materials Project exist and standard probing, CKA, silhouette, matching, steering, and activation-patching tooling can support most of the pipeline, although “public reaction/kinetics datasets with substituent annotations” and “a public materials/crystal encoder” remain unspecified and the proposed route-labeled benchmark must be curated. Resources receive useful partial quantification through “~10 outcomes,” “>=2 distinct mechanistic routes,” and “ESM-2 (8M-650M),” but per-route sample sizes and the other model configurations are not stated. The refuting branch is runnable for the separability test because the design includes “shuffle route labels,” a “randomly-initialized-model control,” an “outcome-only baseline,” and a “surface-feature baseline,” though the intervention-validation branch needs additional specification before execution.
